Table 3 reports one parameter estimate per item under its factor grouping; unreported cross-loadings were coded null. Factor correlations were extracted from the text reporting inter-correlations between the three Turkish TAS-20 factors; the paper describes these as Pearson correlations rather than a separate CFA latent correlation matrix. Estimation method was not reported.
